# `Q-3-11` — Fenced Note Definition Not Supported

> Fenced note definitions cannot be rendered in this output
> format because content coalescing is not yet implemented.

## What this means

A fenced note definition is the multi-paragraph form of a
footnote: the body lives inside a fenced block attached to the
note reference, rather than on a single line after `[^id]:`.

The writer for this output format does not yet coalesce note
content back into the reference location, so it cannot place the
fenced body where the reader expects to see it. The error fires
once per orphan definition.

## Why this happens

Your document uses the fenced form for one or more footnotes and
the selected output format does not yet support coalescing.

## How to fix

If the note body is short enough, rewrite it as an inline
footnote (`text^[body]`). If the body is genuinely
multi-paragraph, switch to an output format that supports
footnotes (HTML, LaTeX) or split the long note into shorter
inline ones.

## Related

- `Q-3-10` — the same limitation for one-line `[^id]: body`
  definitions.
- `Q-3-55` — fenced note definitions are also not supported in
  ANSI output.
